title: Tawang Hosts International Tourism Mart With Buyers From 22 Countries
excerpt: The 14th International Tourism Mart runs October 29-31 at Hotel Vivanta, Tawang, with over 200 participants and 43 international buyers, returning to Arunachal Pradesh for the first time since 2013.
body:
• The 14th International Tourism Mart for the North Eastern Region runs October 29-31, 2026, at Hotel Vivanta in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, returning to Tawang after 13 years.
  • Over 200 participants are expected, including 43 international buyers from 22 countries — among them the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, Russia and the UAE.
  • Reader check: B2B sessions are on October 30 and familiarisation tours for international delegates start from Guwahati on November 1; technical visits cover Tawang Monastery, Jang Waterfall, Tawang War Memorial and PTSO Lake.
  • All eight North Eastern States — Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura — will present destination and combined-circuit products.

Over 200 participants are expected in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, for the 14th International Tourism Mart (ITM) for the North Eastern Region, which runs from October 29 to 31, 2026, at Hotel Vivanta, Tawang. The Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, is organising the event in association with the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and other North Eastern States, Travel Trends Today reported.

The Mart is the Ministry of Tourism's annual flagship event aimed at promoting the North Eastern Region as a tourism destination in domestic and international markets. It serves as a platform for tourism businesses, entrepreneurs, tour operators, government agencies, media and other stakeholders to explore collaboration, strengthen tourism linkages and promote the region's natural, cultural and adventure tourism offerings, according to both Travel Trends Today and India Education Diary, which published the same programme details.

Who is attending

The event is expected to witness participation from 43 international buyers representing 22 countries, including Australia, Bhutan, France, Germany, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Poland, Russia, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Thailand, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom and the United States. Domestic buyers, tourism service providers and sellers from all eight North Eastern States will also participate.

The inaugural programme on October 29, 2026, will be attended by Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, Union Minister for Tourism and Culture, Suresh Gopi, Minister of State for Tourism and Petroleum & Natural Gas, and Pema Khandu, Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh. The programme includes inauguration of the North East Bazaar and cultural performances highlighting regional traditions.

Programme: presentations, B2B sessions and technical visits

The Mart will showcase destination and tourism product presentations by all eight North Eastern States — Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura. The presentations will highlight each state's attractions, experiences and offerings, along with combined tourism circuits and products of the region.

Business-to-Business sessions on October 30, 2026, will facilitate structured interactions between domestic and international buyers and tourism service providers from the North East, aimed at promoting business collaborations, developing tourism products and strengthening market access for tourism entrepreneurs and service providers from the region. A regional meeting of tourism ministers of the North Eastern States will also be held on October 30, chaired by the Union Minister for Tourism and Culture.

Technical sessions will cover building the live events and concert economy in the North East, led by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, and facilitating tourist access to Protected and Restricted Areas, led by the Ministry of Home Affairs. Royal Enfield will present on 'Beyond Destinations: Creating Immersive Journeys in North East India'.

Technical visits are planned to attractions in and around Tawang, including Tawang Monastery, Jaswant Garh War Memorial, Jang Waterfall, Tawang War Memorial, Urgelling Gompa — the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama — Buddha Park, Pankang Teng Tso (PTSO) Lake and Shernup Village. Familiarisation tours for international delegates are scheduled to commence from Guwahati on November 1, 2026. The North East Bazaar will highlight traditional arts, handicrafts, textiles and cultural heritage, with cultural performances and regional cuisines from the eight states.

Return to Tawang after 13 years

The 14th edition marks the Mart's return to Tawang after 13 years, having last hosted the 2nd edition in 2013. The previous edition was held in Gangtok, Sikkim, in November 2025.

For diaspora travellers in the US, UK and Australia — three of the buyer markets named — the practical output to watch is what gets packaged after October 30: combined North East circuits sold by international buyers are the route by which a Tawang, Assam and Meghalaya itinerary becomes bookable from abroad in a single product, rather than assembled state by state. The Protected and Restricted Areas session is directly relevant to foreign-passport and OCI travellers, for whom access paperwork, not interest, is often the barrier to visiting Arunachal Pradesh.
